metadata.name: TalentSift Automated Candidate Evaluator
metadata.intended_purpose: Automated CV scoring, video interview sentiment parsing, and algorithmic candidate filtering.

raw_document_text:
# TalentSift Candidate Evaluator Specification

## Intended Use
TalentSift autonomously scores thousands of inbound job applications, auto-rejecting the bottom 70% percentile prior to hiring manager interviews.

## Risk Management (Article 9)
A risk management procedure was drafted during initial prototype design.

## Data Governance (Article 10)
Training data provenance comprises 120,000 historical corporate hiring resumes scraped from internal company records.

## Bias Examination & Demographic Parity (Article 10(2)(f))
The development team did not conduct bias examination or demographic parity audits across protected attributes due to data privacy constraints. Bias mitigation controls are currently absent.

## Automated Logging (Article 12)
Inference logging is implemented for error debugging in cloud datacenters.

## Transparency (Article 13)
Basic instructions for use are provided in the software administrator portal.

## Human Oversight (Article 14)
Candidate rejections are executed autonomously with no human oversight mechanism. The platform operates without human-in-the-loop validation or manual override prior to sending candidate rejection notices.

## Cybersecurity & Robustness (Article 15)
Standard SSL encryption is configured, but adversarial robustness against resume prompt injection was untested.
